title: The Marina at Sheridan Lake
specs: 383 acre lake with over 7.5 miles of heavily forested shoreline

services.name: Boat Rentals
services.desc: The Marina at Sheridan Lake offers both motorized and non-motorized watercraft to fit your needs for a day exploring Sheridan Lake. We have 11 pontoon boats, 2 aluminum fishing boats, 2 jet skis, 1 Two Passenger Kayak, 3 Canoes, 3 Single Passenger Kayaks, and 4 Stand Up Paddle Boards available for rent from May 15 to September 18. You must be 21 years of age with a valid driver’s license to rent and to operate any of our motorized watercraft. services.name: Floating dock rental
services.desc: The Marina at Sheridan Lake has 113 active boat slips and, NEW for Summer 2025; dry boat, trailer and camper storage. Dry Storage is available year round and is available for boats on trailers, boat trailers, campers, and fifth wheels. Vehicles/Vessels are available to the owner from 8:00am-6:30pm seven days a week from May 1-October 1, available by appointment from October 2-April 30. Summer Storage $750 (May 1-October 1) Yearly Storage $1200 Vehicles Over 30feet +$200 Dry Storage is available for Boats, RVs, 5th Wheels. This storage area is completely fenced in with lighting and security

blurb: Guests can rent boats to explore Sheridan Lake, which has over 7.5 miles of forested shoreline and offers fishing and hiking. The marina provides bait, fishing tackle, convenience foods, and outdoor equipment. Vacation rentals and boat storage are also available.
